prompt.high_level_description: Repair the top band of an existing pixel art background of a ruined burial grove, keeping its exact palette, light, scale, oblique 2.5D camera and fine controlled dusty hand-painted pixel clusters. The far ruins, arches and upper stairs in this band are gone: the low ruined walls and broken stairs behind the grove now end lower, broken off at uneven heights with chipped tops, and above and behind them there is only open sky, one plain flat light dusty grey-mauve colour, completely empty.

compositional_deconstruction.background: Open sky of one flat pale colour above the broken tops of the low ruins.

elements.desc: Plain flat empty pale sky above uneven broken tops of low ruined walls and stairs.
